# kami: Origami Simulator

> kami is a free, open-source interactive origami and paper-folding simulator that responds to physical device posture. Fold a foldable phone or close a laptop lid and the on-screen paper folds along the hinge. It runs in any modern browser and as a native macOS app.

kami uses the Device Posture API, viewport segments, and accelerometer input to detect hinge angle, then animates a folding paper sheet with polygon clipping and 3D canvas rendering. No account, install, or payment required.

## Use

- [App](https://kami.maxwase.eu/): Launch the simulator in your browser
- [Source code](https://github.com/maxwase/kami): Full source on GitHub (TypeScript + Rust/Tauri)

## Features

- Responds to foldable phones, laptop lids, and device posture changes
- Manual fold and flip controls when no hinge sensor is present
- Adjustable paper size (A4, square, custom aspect), colors, and border
- Undo support and motion-stability tuning
- Works offline as an installable PWA; native macOS build via Tauri
